libs.note: BH-2516.0 (BH-2644). The token health reporter seam: token_health_report <kind> <subject> <ok|fail> [expires_at_iso] [error], always rc 0 and never stdout. Since BH-2646 it posts {kind, subject, box, ok, expires_at, error} to /api/account-leases/token-health through bin/jobs-client.sh (curl -m 5, no retry, no ALERTS line); called from bin/oauth-refresh.sh and gh-token.sh mint().

knobs.note: Hours before a token's expiry the health panel flags it red. Mirrors the worker settings row lib.token-health.token_health_warn_h (seeded 24). Registered only: nothing on the box reads it yet.
1 = token_health_report posts, 0 = off. Read by bin/lib/token-health.sh on every call; 0 sends no request.
